headline: OpenAI sets prior review for direct model-access intermediaries and restricts substitute-model training uses
summary: On October 21, OpenAI published Usage Policy changes effective November 20, 2026. They require prior OpenAI review and approval for model-access intermediary platforms or other services that enable third parties to directly access OpenAI models; an application is not covered solely because it integrates OpenAI models into its own features. The policy also bars using OpenAI models or outputs to prepare training materials or signals for models intended as alternatives or substitutes, subject to uses expressly permitted by an applicable agreement. These are stated policy terms; implementation and market effects remain unobserved.
